tool.name: Gene Ontology
tool.description: download versioned Gene Ontology reference files
tool.help:
Downloads nine official Gene Ontology reference files in OBO, OWL, JSON, and OFN formats.
The release version is extracted from the downloaded ``go-basic.obo`` file. The data table records the release version and available filenames.
The ``path`` column points to ``go-basic.obo`` for compatibility with RECAP-PROK Module 4 Functional Comparison.
